aggregation_order: Pre-aggregate many-side fee/settlement/reverse tables before joining where the source query or reconciliation section implies many-to-one.
filters: Use exactly the filters in formula_sql / linked sql_pattern, especially is_active=true, transaction_type/type scope, and group_level_id column scope where runtime supplies it.
formula_sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * ABS(SUM(commission))
    / NULLIF(SUM(charged_amount), 0), 2
  ) AS effective_commission_pct
FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement
WHERE is_active = true
  AND transaction_type = 'forward'
  AND charged_amount > 0;

name: Snapdeal implementation — Effective Commission Rate
sign_convention: Preserve source sign convention; normalize only when rule explicitly says so.
sql_pattern:
SELECT
  seller_code,
  SUM(charged_amount) AS total_gmv,
  SUM(commission) AS total_commission,
  ROUND(100.0 * ABS(SUM(commission)) / NULLIF(SUM(charged_amount), 0), 2) AS effective_commission_pct
FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement
WHERE is_active = true
  AND transaction_type = 'forward'
  AND charged_amount > 0
GROUP BY seller_code;
